# Spotify Project

Authors: [Bernacchia Alessia](https://github.com/AlessiaBernacchia), [Pioda Tommaso](https://github.com/Thetommigun432), [Villani Giacomo](https://github.com/DownToTheGround)

```{r}
library(readr)
library(dplyr)

billboard <- read_csv("billboard.csv", 
                           col_types = cols(url = col_skip(), 
                            song = col_skip(), song = col_skip(), 
                            performer = col_skip(), 
                            instance = col_skip()
                            ))

audio_features <- na.omit(audio_features)

audio_features <- read_csv("audio_features.csv", 
                           col_types = cols(song_id = col_skip(), 
                            performer = col_skip(), song = col_skip(), 
                            spotify_genre = col_skip(), 
                            spotify_track_preview_url = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_explicit = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_album = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_album = col_skip(),
                            spotify_track_id = col_skip()
                            ))

audio_features <- na.omit(audio_features)

print(head(audio_features,10))   
```
